findings.title: Cross-project publication rendering
findings.summary: PR68 makes reusable content and YouTube-to-VK sync paths project-bound; direct base execution and cross-project source/community pairing fail before provider workflow.
findings.action: Retain project-identity, direct-bypass, and cross-project regression coverage.

findings.title: SQLite reliability pragmas
findings.summary: WAL, busy_timeout=5000 and foreign_keys=ON merged in PR61.
findings.action: Retain regression tests only.

findings.title: HTTP client per request
findings.summary: Inventory and major writer/OAuth paths migrated in PR62/63; YouTubeCommentWriter and remaining sites still need exact ownership inventory.
findings.action: Complete lifecycle migration without changing mutation retry semantics.

findings.title: Upload ticket journaled too late
findings.summary: PR66 persists reservation intent before video.save, a dispatch marker before the request, and exact ticket evidence before media transfer.
findings.action: Retain crash/replay regression coverage; reconcile historical live journals separately.

findings.title: Visible remote object treated as reusable
findings.summary: PR66 permits verified replay only or exact owner/video reconciliation under the durable journal stage.
findings.action: Retain exact-identity and legacy-migration regression coverage.

findings.title: Weak upload readiness contract
findings.summary: PR66 requires exact identity, normalized title, minimum duration, expected type, stable processing state, and playability before verified.
findings.action: Retain zero-duration/incomplete-object and delayed-processing tests.

findings.title: Content records not fully project-bound in load/preview/plan
findings.summary: Fresh verification showed parsing already called full record validation; PR68 closed the actual defects by removing implicit project fallback, adding expected project/channel context, rejecting mixed batches, and requiring exact plan coverage.
findings.action: Retain unknown-channel, mismatch, mixed-batch, and exact-coverage tests.

findings.title: YouTube read requests lack bounded retry
findings.summary: YouTubeApiClient safe reads can fail complete scans on transient transport/provider errors.
findings.action: Add explicit classified read-only backoff with bounded attempts and testable timing.

findings.title: Duplicated VK transport and retry classification
findings.summary: Reader, writers and wave gateways retain overlapping HTTP/error logic and need a redaction-safe shared taxonomy.
findings.action: Centralize transport primitives while keeping operation-specific retry policy explicit.

findings.title: No configurable proactive VK limiter
findings.summary: Most flows react to provider errors after the fact and do not share an injectable proactive limiter.
findings.action: Add a configurable conservative limiter only after current primary provider-policy verification.

findings.title: video.save auto_publish/repeat contract
findings.summary: Audits conflict about official parameter support; wallpost=0 is present, other flags require primary/live verification.
findings.action: Run read-only/one-canary contract research before code mandate.

findings.title: Wall publication separated from upload
findings.summary: Operational policies enforce separation in several flows, but no single universal upload postflight contract exists.
findings.action: Manifest wall_mutation_authorized=false plus before/after wall audit.

findings.title: PowerShell/operator fragmentation
findings.summary: Multiple Python launchers, stdout parsing, paths, encodings and latest-ZIP selection were confirmed on audit baseline and not addressed by PR61-68.
findings.action: Fresh inventory then consolidate runner contract.

findings.title: Wave generations and monkeypatch chains
findings.summary: PR68 removed production monkeypatching from the supported sync path and made the base executor internal-only; multiple historical wave generations still require governed retirement.
findings.action: Archive retired paths only after reference scans and supported-entrypoint registry work.

findings.title: Critical executor test coverage
findings.summary: PR66 added deep upload crash/replay coverage and PR68 added project/direct-bypass coverage; broader CLI, provider and script coverage still needs module-specific gates.
findings.action: Expand risk-based coverage without weakening the Wave 1/2 matrices.

findings.title: Album mapping by normalized title
findings.summary: Base sync maps live albums by normalized title and cannot safely represent duplicate names.
findings.action: Exact mapping and explicit conflict.

findings.title: Media cache selection by glob
findings.summary: Existing video_id*.mp4 can be selected before exact yt-dlp final-path and full media integrity checks; PR66 fingerprints the selected file but does not close path authority.
findings.action: Use authoritative yt-dlp final path plus ffprobe and cache fingerprint.

findings.title: System Uploads playlist creates VK album
findings.summary: Later primary-source verification showed playlists.list mine excludes system-generated uploads.
findings.action: Do not implement a fix for this claim.

findings.title: VK chunk/resume upload
findings.summary: No verified provider-supported protocol was established; PR66 solved recovery through journaled intent/ticket and exact reconciliation.
findings.action: Do not invent a chunk/resume protocol.

findings.title: Theological article photo wave
findings.summary: 10/10 postponed posts verified, IDs 12471-12480.
findings.action: Archive old generations; do not rerun Apply.

findings.title: Legendary Poet Shorts exact inventory

findings.title: Lord God upload/Shorts reconciliation
findings.summary: Issues 31/32/36/37/38 remain open; Waves 1-2 prevent blind retry and project bypass but do not establish historical live outcomes.

findings.title: MP3 browser automation boundary
